requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity and manageability solutions, including AI-driven print and scan workflows, to simplify business operations for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require solutions that minimize manual intervention and streamline workflows, as they lack dedicated IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with SMB portal and device management systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Demonstrated deployment of AI-driven productivity features in print and scan workflows; user testing with SMBs shows >80% satisfaction with workflow simplification.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Deliver HP’s lowest business TCO through a combination of cost-efficient ink tank technology and minimal maintenance requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a primary decision driver for SMBs with limited budgets.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink tank system design and maintenance strategy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent benchmark shows TCO at least 10% lower than previous HP SMB products and competitive offerings.

requirements.Title: High Serviceability and Customer Replaceable Parts
requirements.Description: Design the printer for high serviceability with customer-replaceable key components (e.g., maintenance box, printhead assembly), and ensure service center support for non-customer-replaceable items.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged SMBs lack IT support; easy maintenance reduces downtime and service costs.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Supplies Quality, Prod Steward, Tech Reg
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular hardware design and clear documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: At least 80% of common maintenance tasks can be performed by end users; documentation and training materials provided.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated SMB portal for managing multiple printers, targeting office managers and generalist IT users in SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need a simple, unified interface for managing fleets of printers without IT expertise.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with telemetry and device firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal supports management of at least 10 devices per customer; user testing with SMBs shows >80% usability rating.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles for Error Prevention
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and reduce user errors.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service incidents and improves user experience for non-technical users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new bottle and tank interface design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field testing shows <2% incorrect refill incidents over 12 months of use.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS and Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Ensure printer supports Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and the new Advanced View SMB portal for enhanced business solutions.
requirements.Rationale: Future-proofs the product and supports HP’s strategic move towards solutions and services.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software and firmware compatibility with HP’s evolving platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is certified compatible with PaaS and Advanced View SMB portal at launch.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support and Improved Print Speed
requirements.Description: For PDL SKU, provide PDL/PS (Page Description Language/PostScript) support and improve print speed to 25/20 ppm (from current 25/19).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses needs of higher-end SMBs requiring advanced print job compatibility and higher throughput.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU demonstrates print speed of at least 25/20 ppm and passes PDL/PS compatibility tests.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Environmental Certification
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel certification for the printer to meet environmental and sustainability standards.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s sustainability goals and competitive positioning in environmentally conscious markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compliance with Blue Angel criteria.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Blue Angel certification awarded by launch date.

requirements.Title: High Recycled Content in Plastics (60% RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure that at least 60% of the printer’s plastics are made from recycled content, exceeding key competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates HP on sustainability and meets growing customer demand for eco-friendly products.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires supply chain and materials engineering alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and third-party audit confirm ≥60% RCP in plastics.

requirements.Title: AI Solutions for Print, Scan, and Support
requirements.Description: Deploy AI-driven solutions in print, scan, and support functions to optimize workflows and reduce manual intervention.
requirements.Rationale: AI-driven automation is a key differentiator for SMBs seeking efficiency and minimal IT burden.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with device firmware and cloud services.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features are operational at launch and reduce manual steps by at least 30% in key workflows.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing capabilities through the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern, flexible work environments and BYOD trends in SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires app integration and device firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is discoverable and usable via HP App for all supported mobile OS at launch.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability Thresholds
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever comes first) and establish serviceability thresholds for key components.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures predictable support costs and aligns with SMB expectations for reliability.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Supplies Quality, Prod Steward, Tech Reg
requirements.Dependencies: Requires warranty policy alignment and service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published and service processes validated before launch.

requirements.Title: Maintenance-Free or Low Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design the printer to be maintenance-free or require minimal maintenance, with fewer parts to replace over product life.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces total cost of ownership and appeals to SMBs lacking technical staff.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Supplies Quality, Prod Steward, Marketing
requirements.Dependencies: Subject to feasibility investigation and hardware design constraints.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance requirements are at least 30% lower than comparable products; validated by field testing.
